technique_name: Name and define the five freedoms of the First Amendment
description: The First Amendment to the Constitution is often referred to as the Bill of Rights, and its five freedoms protect the rights of Americans. These freedoms are freedom of religion, freedom of speech, freedom of the press, the right to assemble peacefully, and the right to petition the government. Freedom of religion allows Americans to practice any religion they choose without fear of persecution. Freedom of speech includes the right to peacefully express one’s views without fear of consequences.
